title: Late-payment fee on overdue invoices
description: As finance, I want a late fee added to invoices that are paid late, so that late payment is discouraged. 1.5% per 30 days, capped at 10%. Show it in read_invoice.

title: Show net pay in the payroll run summary
description: The payroll run should report total net pay after tax using net_pay.

title: Reminder fee for overdue invoices
description: Finance wants a fixed reminder fee on overdue invoices: none for the first 14 days late, 5.00 from 15 days, 10.00 from 45 days. Computed by reminder_fee in app/invoices.py.

title: Holiday pay in payroll
description: Payroll needs holiday pay: gross pay divided by 260 working days, times the holiday days taken, rounded to the cent. Computed by holiday_pay in app/payroll/service.py.

title: Partner API keys from the X-API-Key header, compared in constant time
description: Security review: partner keys must be read from the X-API-Key header and compared in constant time, and empty keys must never match. check_key in app/auth/keys.py takes the request headers.
